purpose: Teach: てっきり/間抜け/漫才/王女/並木/白馬/舞う/過敏

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、てっきり、本気で、絶対、お休み、絶対、と、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、思っていたわ
lines.en: Aoi, I really thought you were going to take the day off for sure.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate opening. Gentle teasing in the tone — a small smile audible. Relaxed pace, like this is an easy moment between them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨日、葵、本気で、絶対、間抜けな、絶対、ことを、絶対、しちゃったよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、笑い
lines.en: Yesterday I did something pretty silly, and Mei still won't stop laughing about it.
lines.style: Self-deprecating laugh woven through. Light, conspiratorial — inviting Mei into the joke at her own expense. Quick delivery on the punchline.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 土曜日の、本気で、絶対、漫才、絶対、テレビで、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、見たいわ、葵
lines.en: I want to watch that comedy show on Saturday. It'll be on TV.
lines.style: Eager, almost childlike in the wanting. Slight upturn at the end — hopeful. Speaking toward Aoi like she's already saying yes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 絵本の、本気で、絶対、王女、絶対、葵、絶対、子供の頃、絶対、憧れたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: When I was little, I used to dream about being a princess from a storybook.
lines.style: Nostalgic, soft-eyed. Dreamlike pacing — not rushed. A small, private smile in the voice. Trailing gently at the end, like a memory settling.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の近くの、本気で、絶対、並木道、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お気に入りよ
lines.en: That tree-lined path near your shop is one of my favorite places.
lines.style: Quiet affection. Gentle and certain — no question in it. Soft attack, warm through-line. Speaking like she's sharing something she's held onto.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 童話で、本気で、絶対、白馬の王子様、絶対、葵、絶対、想像してたわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I used to imagine meeting a prince on a white horse, like in fairy tales.
lines.style: Wistful, slightly self-conscious — almost laughing at her younger self. Soft and reflective. A touch of wonder still underneath the nostalgia.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、花びら、絶対、ひらひら、絶対、舞うように、絶対、見えるわよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The way petals seem to dance and scatter in your shop — it's so beautiful.
lines.style: Dreamy, almost hypnotized by the image. Slow, lyrical pacing. Soft breathiness on 'dance.' Speaking like she's painting a picture in the air.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、香水に、絶対、過敏に、絶対、反応する、絶対、お客様、絶対、いらっしゃるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Some customers are really sensitive to perfume — they react strongly to it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, practical concern. Grounded, observant tone — the barista noticing what matters. Not complaining, just noting. Clear and steady.
